headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: gold changed shoulders as the AEW Women's World Title found a new champion as Toni Storm vs. Mariah May battled it out, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 7.13 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Storm reclaimed the AEW Women's World Championship from May with a small package counter, becoming a four-time champion in front of a hometown Brisbane crowd.

2021 brought us this moment: VENY stepped through the curtain for the first time against Emi Sakura, appearing on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 8.11 ? a fantastic contest. A close first-round match in AEW's first-ever Women's World Title Eliminator Tournament ? Veny nearly pulled off a shock finish before Emi Sakura, complete with a Freddie Mercury-tribute mustache, escaped with a tiger driver, capped by a mid-air slap for good measure.
On this day in 2023, Rush & Vance kicked off their AEW journey as a team in a Tornado Tag match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.62.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Rin Kadokura made a statement, debuting in the main event against Aja Kong, appearing on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 6.17.
Looking back to 2021, when Mei Suruga made their AEW debut against Yuka Sakazaki, appearing on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 6.55.
